```{r,fig.width=16, fig.height= 9.1}
## ======================================================================
## ONE-FILE SCRIPT (UPDATED)
## Mixed crops (2.5 acres each): AV vs AgOnly
## ✅ Outputs represent Net Present Value (NPV) at 3% discount rate
## ✅ Baseline policy: MACRS+NOL
## ✅ Tornado heat-bar includes Policy + Location

## ======================================================================

discount_rate <- 0.03

system_kw_ac <- 818
capex_per_kw <- 1678
pv_cost      <- system_kw_ac * capex_per_kw


inverter_replacement_year <- 15
inv_salv_rate <- 0.10  # inverter salvage fraction at year T (if replaced)
## Inverter replacement cost ($/kW-AC)
inverter_replacement_cost_per_kw <- 70.87


# PV economics
P_elec               <- 0.07
solar_om_cost_per_kw <- 23.60
solar_om_cost        <- solar_om_cost_per_kw * system_kw_ac


salvage_rate <- 0.10
bonus_rate   <- 0.00   # you keep this for non-policy parts; policy handles bonus100 internally
itc_rate     <- 0.00   # baseline in simple cashflow section (policy engine overrides this)

# MACRS (PV 5-yr)
macrs_pv <- c(0.20, 0.32, 0.192, 0.1152, 0.1152, 0.0576)

# Taxes
federal_tax_rate  <- 0.21
state_tax_rate    <- 0.0884
combined_tax_rate <- federal_tax_rate + state_tax_rate * (1 - federal_tax_rate)

# Land and land-loss
land_rent_per_acre <- 0
annual_land_rent   <- land_rent_per_acre * total_acres
alpha <- 0.10

# Ag machinery MACRS (7-yr)
macrs_ag <- c(0.1429, 0.2449, 0.1749, 0.1249, 0.0893, 0.0892, 0.0893, 0.0446)

# Loan & inverter
loan_term <- 15
interest_rate <- 0.05
loan_payment <- (pv_cost * interest_rate) / (1 - (1 + interest_rate)^(-loan_term))


# Plot site

  El_Centro   = 1987900.40,

  Bakersfield = 1821452.40,

stopifnot(site_for_plots %in% names(G_solar_base))

getv <- function(vec, key, fallback = 0) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(unname(vec[key]))
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) fallback else v
}

add_npv_cols <- function(df, r = discount_rate) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      DF       = (1 + r)^(-Year),
      PV_NetCF = Net_CF * DF,
      Cum_NPV  = cumsum(PV_NetCF)
    )
}

  Lettuce_Romaine = 298.01,  Lettuce_Iceberg = 322.85, CoverCrop = 23.64,
  Potato = 259.97, Onion = 436.11, Broccoli=459.70,

## -----------------------------
## 4) MIXED CROP SETUP
## -----------------------------
crops_mixed <- c("Tomato", "Garbanzo", "Corn", "Bell_Peppers")

req <- crops_mixed
for (v in c("yield","price","total_cost","irrig_cost","water_saving","lambda",
            "capital_investment_per_acre","salvage_value_per_acre")) {

## -----------------------------
## 5) TAX HELPERS + POLICY TABLE
## -----------------------------
apply_nol_80 <- function(ti_pre, nol_beg) {
  if (ti_pre > 0) {
    max_offset <- 0.80 * ti_pre
    nol_used   <- min(nol_beg, max_offset)
    ti_post    <- ti_pre - nol_used
    nol_end    <- nol_beg - nol_used
  } else {
    ti_post <- ti_pre
    nol_end <- nol_beg + (-ti_pre)
  }
  list(TI_post = ti_post, NOL_end = nol_end)
}

itc_sale_price <- 0.90  # if sold, cash = 0.90 * ITC amount in Year 1

policy_tbl <- tibble(
  Policy = c("MACRS",
             "MACRS+NOL",
             "MACRS+ITC",
             "MACRS+NOL+ITC",
             "MACRS+NOL+ITC sold Y1",
             "Bonus 100% (Y1 only, NO MACRS)",
             "Bonus 100%+NOL"),
  itc_rate      = c(0.00, 0.00, 0.30, 0.30, 0.30, 0.00, 0.00),
  use_nol       = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE),
  sell_itc      = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE),
  pv_dep_method = c("macrs","macrs","macrs","macrs","macrs","bonus100","bonus100")
)

## -----------------------------
## 6) CORE ENGINES (AV + AgOnly)
## -----------------------------
agonly_table <- function(
  crops = crops_mixed,
  years_in = NULL,
  total_acres_in = NULL,
  discount_rate_in = discount_rate
) {
  if (is.null(years_in))       years_in <- years
  if (is.null(total_acres_in)) total_acres_in <- total_acres

  n_crops       <- length(crops)
  area_per_crop <- total_acres_in / n_crops

  ag_basis_total <- sum(vapply(crops, function(cr) getv(capital_investment_per_acre, cr, 0) * area_per_crop, numeric(1)))
  ag_salv_total  <- sum(vapply(crops, function(cr) getv(salvage_value_per_acre,     cr, 0) * area_per_crop, numeric(1)))

  rows <- vector("list", years_in + 1)

  rows[[1]] <- tibble(
    Scenario           = "AgOnly (mixed crops)",
    Year               = 0,
    Area_Acres         = total_acres_in,
    Revenue_Crops      = 0,
    Revenue_Ag_Salvage = 0,
    Cost_Crops         = 0,
    Cost_Irrig         = 0,
    Dep_Machinery      = 0,
    Taxable_Income     = 0,
    Taxes_Paid         = 0,
    Net_CF             = -ag_basis_total
  )

  for (y in 1:years_in) {
    revenue_crops <- 0
    cost_crops    <- 0
    cost_irrig    <- 0

    for (cr in crops) {
      revenue_crops <- revenue_crops + getv(yield, cr, 0) * getv(price, cr, 0) * area_per_crop
      cost_crops    <- cost_crops    + getv(total_cost, cr, 0) * area_per_crop
      cost_irrig    <- cost_irrig    + getv(irrig_cost, cr, 0) * area_per_crop
    }

    revenue_salv <- if (y == years_in) ag_salv_total else 0
    dep_mach     <- if (y <= length(macrs_ag)) ag_basis_total * macrs_ag[y] else 0

    taxable_income <- (revenue_crops + revenue_salv) - cost_crops - cost_irrig - dep_mach
    taxes_paid <- max(0, taxable_income * combined_tax_rate)

    net_cf <- (revenue_crops + revenue_salv) - cost_crops - cost_irrig - taxes_paid

    rows[[y + 1]] <- tibble(
      Scenario           = "AgOnly (mixed crops)",
      Year               = y,
      Area_Acres         = total_acres_in,
      Revenue_Crops      = revenue_crops,
      Revenue_Ag_Salvage = revenue_salv,
      Cost_Crops         = cost_crops,
      Cost_Irrig         = cost_irrig,
      Dep_Machinery      = dep_mach,
      Taxable_Income     = taxable_income,
      Taxes_Paid         = taxes_paid,
      Net_CF             = net_cf
    )
  }

  df <- bind_rows(rows)
  add_npv_cols(df, r = discount_rate_in)
}

av_table_mixed_policy <- function(
  site = "Davis",
  crops = crops_mixed,
  policy = "MACRS+NOL",
  lam_override = NA_real_,
  years_in = NULL,

  P_elec_in = P_elec,
  capex_per_kw_in = capex_per_kw,
  solar_om_cost_per_kw_in = solar_om_cost_per_kw,
  interest_rate_in = interest_rate,
  salvage_rate_in = salvage_rate,
  alpha_in = alpha,
  water_saving_in = water_saving,
  discount_rate_in = discount_rate
) {
  if (is.null(years_in)) years_in <- years
  stopifnot(site %in% names(G_solar_base))
  stopifnot(policy %in% policy_tbl$Policy)

  pol <- policy_tbl %>% filter(Policy == policy) %>% slice(1)
  itc_rate_local <- pol$itc_rate
  use_nol_local  <- pol$use_nol
  sell_itc_local <- pol$sell_itc
  dep_method     <- pol$pv_dep_method

  base_kwh <- as.numeric(G_solar_base[[site]])

  n_crops          <- length(crops)
  area_total_av    <- total_acres * (1 - alpha_in)
  area_per_crop_av <- area_total_av / n_crops

  pv_cost_local <- system_kw_ac * capex_per_kw_in
  # Inverter replacement cost (local): $/kW-AC * kW-AC
inv_cost_local <- inverter_replacement_cost_per_kw * system_kw_ac

  # Basis reduction for ITC
  basis <- pv_cost_local * (1 - itc_rate_local/2)

  # PV depreciation streams
  bonus_dep_y1 <- 0
  if (dep_method == "macrs") {
    macrs_sched <- basis * macrs_pv
  } else if (dep_method == "bonus100") {
    bonus_dep_y1 <- basis
    macrs_sched  <- rep(0, length(macrs_pv))
  } else {
    stop("Unknown pv_dep_method in policy_tbl.")
  }

  # Inverter depreciation stream (5-yr MACRS starting replacement year)
  inv_dep_stream <- numeric(years_in)
  #
# Inverter replacement cost (local): $/kW-AC * kW-AC
inv_cost_local <- inverter_replacement_cost_per_kw * system_kw_ac

# Inverter depreciation stream (5-yr MACRS starting replacement year)
inv_dep_stream <- numeric(years_in)

if (inverter_replacement_year <= years_in) {
  s <- inverter_replacement_year
  for (i in seq_along(macrs_pv)) {
    yr <- s + i - 1
    if (yr <= years_in) {
      inv_dep_stream[yr] <- inv_dep_stream[yr] + inv_cost_local * macrs_pv[i]
    }
  }
}

  # Crop basis/salvage on AV area
  ag_basis_av <- sum(vapply(crops, function(cr) getv(capital_investment_per_acre, cr, 0) * area_per_crop_av, numeric(1)))
  ag_salv_av  <- sum(vapply(crops, function(cr) getv(salvage_value_per_acre,     cr, 0) * area_per_crop_av, numeric(1)))

  lam_of <- function(cr) {
    if (!is.na(lam_override)) return(lam_override)
    getv(lambda, cr, 0)
  }
  ws_of <- function(cr) getv(water_saving_in, cr, 0.08)

  # Loan
  loan_payment_local <- (pv_cost_local * interest_rate_in) / (1 - (1 + interest_rate_in)^(-loan_term))
  loan_balance <- pv_cost_local

  solar_om_total <- solar_om_cost_per_kw_in * system_kw_ac

  # ITC + NOL state
  itc_cf <- itc_rate_local * pv_cost_local
  nol_cf <- 0

  rows <- vector("list", years_in + 1)
  rows[[1]] <- tibble(
    Scenario = paste0("AV (mixed crops, ", site, ", ", policy, ")"),
    Site     = site,
    Policy   = policy,
    Year     = 0,
    Net_CF   = -ag_basis_av
  )

  for (y in 1:years_in) {
    rev_crop <- 0; cost_crop <- 0; cost_irrig <- 0
    for (cr in crops) {
      rev_crop   <- rev_crop   + getv(yield, cr, 0) * getv(price, cr, 0) * area_per_crop_av * (1 + lam_of(cr))
      cost_crop  <- cost_crop  + getv(total_cost, cr, 0) * area_per_crop_av
      cost_irrig <- cost_irrig + getv(irrig_cost, cr, 0) * area_per_crop_av * (1 - ws_of(cr))
    }

    rev_solar    <- base_kwh * (1 - 0.005*(y-1)) * P_elec_in
    rev_pv_salv  <- if (y == years_in) salvage_rate_in * pv_cost_local else 0
    rev_ag_salv  <- if (y == years_in) ag_salv_av else 0
    rev_inv_salv <- if (y == years_in && years_in >= inverter_replacement_year) inv_salv_rate * inv_cost_local else 0

    inv_cash <- if (y == inverter_replacement_year) inv_cost_local else 0

    loan_interest  <- if (y <= loan_term) loan_balance * interest_rate_in else 0
    loan_payment_y <- if (y <= loan_term) loan_payment_local else 0
    loan_principal <- if (y <= loan_term) loan_payment_y - loan_interest else 0
    loan_balance   <- if (y <= loan_term) loan_balance - loan_principal else loan_balance
    if (abs(loan_balance) < 1e-6) loan_balance <- 0

    dep_solar <- if (y <= length(macrs_sched)) macrs_sched[y] else 0
    dep_inv   <- inv_dep_stream[y]
    dep_mach  <- if (y <= length(macrs_ag)) ag_basis_av * macrs_ag[y] else 0
    dep_bonus <- if (y == 1) bonus_dep_y1 else 0

    ti_pre <- (rev_crop + rev_solar + rev_pv_salv + rev_ag_salv + rev_inv_salv) -
      cost_crop - cost_irrig - solar_om_total - annual_land_rent -
      loan_interest - dep_solar - dep_inv - dep_mach - dep_bonus

    # NOL (80% limit)
    if (isTRUE(use_nol_local)) {
      nol_res <- apply_nol_80(ti_pre, nol_cf)
      ti_post <- nol_res$TI_post
      nol_cf  <- nol_res$NOL_end
    } else {
      ti_post <- ti_pre
      nol_cf  <- 0
    }

    taxes_pre_credit <- max(0, ti_post * combined_tax_rate)

    itc_cash_sale <- 0
    itc_used <- 0
    if (isTRUE(sell_itc_local)) {
      if (y == 1 && itc_cf > 0) {
        itc_cash_sale <- itc_sale_price * itc_cf
        itc_cf <- 0
      }
      taxes_paid <- taxes_pre_credit
    } else {
      if (itc_cf > 0 && taxes_pre_credit > 0) {
        itc_used <- min(itc_cf, taxes_pre_credit)
        itc_cf <- itc_cf - itc_used
      }
      taxes_paid <- max(0, taxes_pre_credit - itc_used)
    }

    net_cf <- (rev_crop + rev_solar + rev_pv_salv + rev_ag_salv + rev_inv_salv + itc_cash_sale) -
      cost_crop - cost_irrig - solar_om_total - annual_land_rent -
      loan_payment_y - inv_cash - taxes_paid

    rows[[y + 1]] <- tibble(
      Scenario = paste0("AV (mixed crops, ", site, ", ", policy, ")"),
      Site     = site,
      Policy   = policy,
      Year     = y,
      Net_CF   = net_cf
    )
  }

  df <- bind_rows(rows)
  add_npv_cols(df, r = discount_rate_in)
}

## -----------------------------
## 7) BUILD TABLES (AV + AgOnly)
## -----------------------------
base_policy <- "MACRS+NOL"
base_site   <- site_for_plots

av_tbl <- av_table_mixed_policy(
  site   = base_site,
  crops  = crops_mixed,
  policy = base_policy
)

df_agonly <- agonly_table(
  crops = crops_mixed
)

# Quick check
print(av_tbl %>% summarise(NPV_25yr = last(Cum_NPV)))
print(df_agonly %>% summarise(NPV_25yr = last(Cum_NPV)))
```

```{r,fig.width=16, fig.height= 9.1}
## =========================================================
## 8) TORNADO HEAT-BAR (NPV @ 3%)  — Mixed crops
## Includes:
##  - Discount rate sensitivity (0–7%)
##  - MACRS+NOL baseline policy
##  - Left-side labels include tested ranges
##  - Fix NA parameter label
##  - Electricity price bar is smooth (no stripes)
##  - Clean white background (no grey grid)
## =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(scales); library(purrr); library(stringr); library(tibble)
})

## ---- Baseline choices (edit if needed) ----
scenario_name <- "Mixed crops (Tomato + Garbanzo + Corn + Bell peppers)"
base_policy   <- "MACRS+NOL"
base_site     <- site_for_plots   # uses your earlier site_for_plots
# baseline discount rate must already exist in your script:
# discount_rate <- 0.03

## ---- Sensitivity specification (numeric parameters + discount rate) ----
sens_spec_num <- tibble(
  Param = c("Electricity price ($/kWh)","PV CapEx ($/kW-AC)","Solar O&M ($/kW-yr)",
            "Yield change λ (uniform override)","Loan interest rate","PV salvage rate",
            "Land-loss α","Water-saving factor","Discount rate (NPV)"),
  key   = c("P_elec","capex_per_kw","solar_om_cost_per_kw",
            "lambda_override","interest_rate","salvage_rate","alpha","water_saving_pct","discount_rate"),
  low   = c(0.02, 1000, 15, -0.30, 0.03, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  high  = c(0.11, 3000, 30,  0.30, 0.10, 0.15, 0.50, 0.25, 0.08)
)

## ---- Abbreviations (MUST match Param strings exactly) ----
abbr_map <- c(
  "Electricity price ($/kWh)"         = "Elec price",
  "PV CapEx ($/kW-AC)"                = "PV CapEx",
  "Solar O&M ($/kW-yr)"               = "Solar O&M",
  "Yield change λ (uniform override)" = "Yield λ",
  "Loan interest rate"                = "Loan rate",
  "PV salvage rate"                   = "PV salvage",
  "Land-loss α"                       = "Land-loss α",
  "Water-saving factor"               = "Water saving",
  "Discount rate (NPV)"               = "Discount rate",
  "Tax policy scenario"               = "Policy",
  "Location (site)"                   = "Location"
)

legend_tbl <- tibble(
  Param_short = c("Elec price","PV CapEx","Solar O&M","Yield λ","Loan rate","PV salvage",
                  "Land-loss α","Water saving","Discount rate","Policy","Location"),
  LegendLab   = c("Electricity price",
                  "PV CapEx",
                  "Solar O&M",
                  "Yield change (λ)",
                  "Loan interest rate",
                  "PV salvage rate",
                  "Land-loss (α)",
                  "Water-saving factor",
                  "Discount rate",
                  "Tax policy scenario",
                  "Solar irradiance site")
)

## ---- Formatting helpers ----
fmt_money <- function(v) ifelse(abs(v) >= 1e6,
                               paste0("$", round(v/1e6, 2), "M"),
                               paste0("$", round(v/1e3, 0), "k"))
fmt_money2 <- function(v) scales::dollar(v, accuracy = 1)
fmt_pct    <- function(x) paste0(round(100*x, 1), "%")
fmt_rate   <- function(x) paste0(round(100*x, 1), "%")

## ---- Wrapper: return 25-year NPV for AV mixed crops under overrides ----
av_total_mixed_npv <- function(policy = base_policy, site = base_site, overrides = list()) {

  # start from your script's baseline globals
  P_elec_l <- P_elec
  capex_l  <- capex_per_kw
  om_l     <- solar_om_cost_per_kw
  r_l      <- interest_rate
  salv_l   <- salvage_rate
  alpha_l  <- alpha
  ws_l     <- water_saving
  lam_ov   <- NA_real_
  disc_l   <- discount_rate

  for (nm in names(overrides)) {
    if (nm == "water_saving_pct") {
      ws_val <- overrides[[nm]]
      ws_l <- setNames(rep(ws_val, length(ws_l)), names(ws_l))
      ws_l <- pmin(pmax(ws_l, 0), 0.90)
    } else if (nm == "lambda_override") {
      lam_ov <- overrides[[nm]]
    } else if (nm == "discount_rate") {
      disc_l <- overrides[[nm]]
    } else if (nm == "P_elec") P_elec_l <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "capex_per_kw") capex_l <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "solar_om_cost_per_kw") om_l <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "interest_rate") r_l <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "salvage_rate") salv_l <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "alpha") alpha_l <- overrides[[nm]]
  }

  av_table_mixed_policy(
    site = site,
    crops = crops_mixed,
    policy = policy,
    lam_override = lam_ov,
    P_elec_in = P_elec_l,
    capex_per_kw_in = capex_l,
    solar_om_cost_per_kw_in = om_l,
    interest_rate_in = r_l,
    salvage_rate_in = salv_l,
    alpha_in = alpha_l,
    water_saving_in = ws_l,
    discount_rate_in = disc_l
  ) %>%
    summarise(v = last(Cum_NPV)) %>%
    pull(v)
}

## ---- Baseline and sensitivity results ----
base_val <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site)

out_num <- purrr::pmap_dfr(sens_spec_num, function(Param, key, low, high) {

  lo <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                           overrides = setNames(list(low), key))
  hi <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                           overrides = setNames(list(high), key))

  # special handling (keeps your original logic explicit)
  if (key == "lambda_override") {
    lo <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                             overrides = list(lambda_override = low))
    hi <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                             overrides = list(lambda_override = high))
  }
  if (key == "water_saving_pct") {
    lo <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                             overrides = list(water_saving_pct = low))
    hi <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                             overrides = list(water_saving_pct = high))
  }
  if (key == "discount_rate") {
    lo <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                             overrides = list(discount_rate = low))
    hi <- av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = base_site,
                             overrides = list(discount_rate = high))
  }

  tibble(
    Scenario = scenario_name,
    Param    = Param,
    Baseline = base_val,
    Min      = pmin(lo, hi),
    Max      = pmax(lo, hi)
  )
})

# categorical: policy
pol_vals <- policy_tbl$Policy
pol_outcomes <- map_dbl(pol_vals, ~av_total_mixed_npv(policy = .x, site = base_site))
out_pol <- tibble(
  Scenario = scenario_name,
  Param    = "Tax policy scenario",
  Baseline = base_val,
  Min      = min(pol_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE),
  Max      = max(pol_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# categorical: site
site_vals <- names(G_solar_base)
site_outcomes <- map_dbl(site_vals, ~av_total_mixed_npv(policy = base_policy, site = .x))
out_site <- tibble(
  Scenario = scenario_name,
  Param    = "Location (site)",
  Baseline = base_val,
  Min      = min(site_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE),
  Max      = max(site_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE)
)

res_abs <- bind_rows(out_num, out_pol, out_site) %>%
  mutate(Impact = abs(Max - Min)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Impact))

## ---- Reference lines: AgOnly NPV + AV baseline NPV ----
agonly_npv_val <- agonly_table(crops = crops_mixed, discount_rate_in = discount_rate) %>%
  summarise(v = last(Cum_NPV)) %>% pull(v)

ref_lines <- tibble(
  Scenario = scenario_name,
  Type = c("AgOnly (reference NPV)", "AV baseline NPV"),
  x    = c(agonly_npv_val, base_val)
)

## ---- Plot prep (no NA labels) ----
res_plot <- res_abs %>%
  mutate(
    Param_short = recode(Param, !!!abbr_map),
    Param_short = if_else(is.na(Param_short), Param, Param_short)  # safety: never NA
  ) %>%
  mutate(Param_short = factor(Param_short, levels = unique(Param_short)))

## ---- Heat tiles data (smooth bars, especially electricity) ----
n_tiles <- 900
heat_df <- res_plot %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(x_seq = list(seq(Min, Max, length.out = n_tiles))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Scenario, Param_short, x_seq) %>%
  unnest(x_seq) %>%
  rename(x = x_seq)

## ---- x-limits & breaks ----
lims <- res_plot %>%
  summarise(mx = max(abs(c(Min, Max, Baseline)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(mx_all = pmax(mx, max(abs(ref_lines$x)), na.rm = TRUE),
         xmin = -mx_all * 1.06, xmax = mx_all * 1.06)

x_breaks <- pretty(c(lims$xmin, lims$xmax), n = 5)

## ---- Range strings for left-side labels ----
range_tbl <- sens_spec_num %>%
  mutate(Param_short = recode(Param, !!!abbr_map)) %>%
  mutate(range_txt = dplyr::case_when(
    key == "P_elec"               ~ paste0("$", sprintf("%.2f", low), " to $", sprintf("%.2f", high), " /kWh"),
    key == "capex_per_kw"         ~ paste0(fmt_money2(low), " to ", fmt_money2(high), " /kW-AC"),
    key == "solar_om_cost_per_kw" ~ paste0(fmt_money2(low), " to ", fmt_money2(high), " /kW-yr"),
    key == "lambda_override"      ~ paste0(fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high)),
    key == "interest_rate"        ~ paste0(fmt_rate(low), " to ", fmt_rate(high)),
    key == "salvage_rate"         ~ paste0(fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high)),
    key == "alpha"                ~ paste0(fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high)),
    key == "water_saving_pct"     ~ paste0(fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high)),
    key == "discount_rate"        ~ paste0(fmt_rate(low), " to ", fmt_rate(high)),
    TRUE ~ ""
  )) %>%
  select(Param_short, range_txt)

labels_once <- res_plot %>%
  distinct(Scenario, Param_short) %>%
  left_join(legend_tbl, by = "Param_short") %>%
  left_join(range_tbl,  by = "Param_short") %>%
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      Param_short %in% c("Policy","Location"),
      LegendLab,
      paste0(LegendLab, " (", range_txt, ")")
    ),
    x_lab = lims$xmin - 0.06*(lims$xmax - lims$xmin)
  )

## ---- Label reference lines on top row ----
top_row <- levels(res_plot$Param_short)[1]
ref_labels_top <- ref_lines %>%
  mutate(
    Param_short = top_row,
    label = if_else(Type == "AgOnly (reference NPV)",
                    paste0("AgOnly NPV: ", scales::dollar(x)),
                    paste0("AV base NPV: ", scales::dollar(x))),
    y_nudge = if_else(Type == "AgOnly (reference NPV)", -0.45, +0.45)
  )

## ---- Subtitle pieces (optional) ----
alpha_label2 <- scales::percent(alpha, accuracy = 1)
delta_label2 <- scales::percent(0.08, accuracy = 1)
lambda_label2 <- "λ baseline:\nTomato - 30%, Corn - 6%, Garbanzo +1%, Bell Pepper +3%"

## ---- Plot ----
p_heat <- ggplot() +
  geom_blank(data = heat_df, aes(x = lims$xmin, y = Param_short)) +
  geom_blank(data = heat_df, aes(x = lims$xmax, y = Param_short)) +

  geom_tile(
    data  = heat_df,
    aes(x = x, y = Param_short, fill = x),
    height = 0.75,
    width  = (lims$xmax - lims$xmin) / n_tiles   # smooth / consistent
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_vline(
    data = ref_lines,
    aes(xintercept = x, linetype = Type),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_label(
    data = ref_labels_top,
    aes(x = x, y = Param_short, label = label),
    size = 3.1, label.size = 0.65, fill = "white", color = "black",
    vjust = -0.1, nudge_y = ref_labels_top$y_nudge
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Scenario, scales = "free_x") +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "NPV ($)",
    low = "#E31A1C", mid = "#FFD92F", high = "#1A9850",
    midpoint = 0, labels = scales::dollar_format(accuracy = 1e5)
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("AgOnly (reference NPV)" = "solid", "AV baseline NPV" = "dotted")
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = fmt_money,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.08))
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity of 25-year AV Net Present Value (NPV) (mixed crops)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      
      " Base Policy = ", base_policy,
      " |discount rate r = ", scales::percent(discount_rate, accuracy = 0.1), " | Site = ", base_site, " | α = ", alpha_label2, " | δ = ", delta_label2, " | ", lambda_label2,
      "\nBars show the 25-year NPV range"
    ),
    x = "25-Year Net Present Value (NPV, constant 2025 $)",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),

  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),

  plot.title = element_text(
    face = "bold",
    size = 18,
    hjust = 0.5
  ),

  legend.position = "right",
  legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),

  panel.spacing.y = unit(1.2,"lines"),
  plot.margin     = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 160)
)+
 coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  geom_text(
    data = labels_once,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = Param_short, label = label),
    hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.3, color = "grey15",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

print(p_heat)

## -----------------------------
## 9) Optional: Ranking plot (NPV impact)
## -----------------------------
rank_df <- res_abs %>%
  mutate(
    Param_short = recode(Param, !!!abbr_map),
    Param_short = if_else(is.na(Param_short), Param, Param_short),
    Param_short = factor(Param_short, levels = rev(unique(Param_short)))
  )

p_rank <- ggplot(rank_df, aes(x = Impact, y = Param_short, fill = Impact)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::dollar_format(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),
    guide  = guide_axis(angle = 30)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low  = "#1A9850", mid  = "#FFD92F", high = "#D73027",
    midpoint = median(rank_df$Impact, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "Impact\n(Max - Min,\n$ million)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Parameter influence ranking (from tornado sensitivity)",
    subtitle = paste0(
  "r = ", scales::percent(discount_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
  " | ", base_policy, " | ", base_site,
  " | α=", alpha_label2, ", δ=", delta_label2,
  "\nBars = NPV range; lines = AgOnly (solid) & AV base (dotted)."
),
    x = "Impact on 25-year NPV ($ million)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_rank)

ggsave(
  filename = "C:/MS_Thesis/Paper_manuscript/Dr_majdis_feedback/Fig_2.5_Tornado_NPV.png",
  plot = p_heat,
  width = 16,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
